content.text:
The series **converges**. Wolfram|Alpha's "Sum convergence" pod for Σ 1/(n³+1), n = 1 to ∞, reads "converges," and its infinite-sum pod gives a closed form in terms of the digamma function.

This agrees with the standard argument: 1/(n³+1) < 1/n³ for every n, and Σ 1/n³ is a p-series with p = 3 > 1, so the series converges by comparison.

The series **converges**. Wolfram|Alpha's "Sum convergence" pod for Σ 1/(n³+1), n = 1 to ∞, reads "converges," and its infinite-sum pod gives a closed form in terms of the digamma function.

This agrees with the standard argument: 1/(n³+1) < 1/n³ for every n, and Σ 1/n³ is a p-series with p = 3 > 1, so the series converges by comparison.
